company.name: inBuild
company.shortDescription: inBuild is a powerful web-based application that provides financial automation and intelligent accounts payable solutions for home builders.
company.description:
inBuild is a SaaS company looking to change the way construction accounts payable is approached from the ground up. We offer construction businesses an intelligent accounts payable solution unlike any other on the market. Bridge the growing gap between email and legacy software: extract incoming invoices, capture data fields, and route documents to the right team members for review. All that data flows seamlessly into the project budget to provide real-time, system-wide visibility into the financial health of any given project. Spend less time on manual data entry and leverage project data to improve your accounts payable. Save time, money, and increase accuracy by allowing artificial intelligence to handle the tedium.

inBuild is the construction industry's most intelligent accounts payable solution.

aiResearchSummary.text: inBuild is focused on developing a system that enhances financial automation for home builders. The system includes a database designed to store and manage data related to emails, projects, vendors, and invoices. This technology aims to streamline business accounting processes by automating the handling of financial documents and transactions, thereby improving efficiency in accounts payable operations. This aligns with inBuild's mission to provide intelligent financial solutions tailored for the home building industry.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Pre Seed round raised $500,000, or 18.18% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $12,656,000 to $12,656,000, a 1x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
